Harbour bridge reopens after two years of repairs

By Priya Natarajan

1 October 2026
SHARE_TEXT Share on social Email

The harbour bridge reopened to traffic on Wednesday morning, ending two years of closures, detours, and long queues for the thousands of commuters who cross the estuary every day.

Engineers replaced every one of the bridge's original steel cables, resurfaced the deck, and installed a new drainage system designed to cope with the heavier storms forecast for the coming decades.

A long road to reopening

The closure was first announced after an inspection found corrosion in the main span, and the council warned residents that the work could take longer than expected if the weather turned.

We are proud to give the bridge back to the people who rely on it every single day.

Local businesses on both sides of the water said trade had suffered during the works, but most welcomed the reopening and the return of passing customers.
